Commentary.Commentary: Muneeba Ali is out in the middle with Sidra Ameen for the run chase. Shamilia Connell will start the proceedings for West Indies Women.
The players are out in the middle for the run chase.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, West Indies Women have posted a total of 116 runs on the board and will be hoping for their bowlers to defend this. For Pakistan Women, the onus is on their batters to chase this down. Which side will get over the line? Let's find out together. Chase coming up shortly...

Pakistan Women were excellent with the ball. They used six bowlers throughout their innings and all the bowlers were economical. Nida Dar chipped two wickets and was certainly the pick of the bowlers. Tuba Hassan, Nashra Sandhu, Fatima Sana and Sadia Iqbal have one in their kitty.

West Indies Women will be upset with how things ended for them. They have managed to post a total of 116 runs. It is a low one but if bowled well, they can pull out a win. Opting to bat first, West Indies Women made a steady start, but kept on losing wickets at regular intervals. They lost a wicket whenever a good partnership was brewing. They will look to get some early wickets now and claw their way into the game.
Tossed up around middle, Afy Fletcher has chipped this behind the fielder at cover and they run a couple.
Flighted outside off, Afy Fletcher has swept this towards deep square leg for a couple.
Full outside off, Trishan Holder gets this through towards extra-cover for a single.
Fuller one outside off, Trishan Holder looks to cut but misses out.
Trishan Holder walks in.

OUT! Easy pickings for Muneeba Ali as she earns yet another stumping in this game. Tossed up outside off, Shabika Gajnabi looks to hit this over cover but fails to connect as Muneeba Ali collects it and removes the bails.
Commentary.Howout: st Muneeba Ali b Nashra Sandhu

Commentary.Commentary: Short outside off, Shabika Gajnabi looks to reverse sweep but misses out.
Nashra Sandhu to bowl the final over.
Fuller one around off, Shabika Gajnabi has driven this towards deep extra-cover for a single.
Flatter outside off, Shabika Gajnabi has smashed this toward deep mid-wicket and they take a single. Back-up was sloppy and they earn a single more as overthrows.

Lands it just outside off, Afy Fletcher moves to her right to sweep it but misses and gets rapped on her pads. A loud appeal but the finger stays down. Nida Dar goes upstairs. Ball Tracking shows that it was missing the stumps and the onfield decision stands NOT OUT!
Afy Fletcher walks in.

OUT! Straight and full within the stumps and Nida Dar removes Aaliyah Alleyne from the middle. Aaliyah Alleyne as looking for a wild swing of her bat but misses out completely as the ball crashes into the stumps.
Fuller one around middle, Aaliyah Alleyne has pushed this back towards the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, Shabika Gajnabi has drilled this to long off for a single.
Nida Dar is back on.
Tossed up around middle, Shabika Gajnabi has drilled this towards long on for a single.
Short one around middle, Aaliyah Alleyne has slogged this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around middle, Shabika Gajnabi has pushed this towards dep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower one outside off on a length, Aaliyah Alleyne looks to slog but misses out. The keeper fails to connect as they run a single of deflection from Muneeba Ali.
Full and around off, Shabika Gajnabi has drilled this towards long off for a single.
Tossed up around pads, Shabika Gajnabi edges this onto her calf. She looks in some pain.
Full and wide outside off, Shabika Gajnabi cuts this to point for a quick single.
Tossed-up around off, Aaliyah Alleyne has chipped this towards sweeper cover for a single.
Length delivery on top of off, Shabika Gajnabi slaps this past the bowler for a single.
Slower one around off, Aaliyah Alleyne has lofted thsi towards sweeper cover for a single.
Slower one on off, Shabika Gajnabi tips it to short third man and they run for it.
Flatter one around off, Aaliyah Alleyne has cut this towards point for a single.
Full and around off, Aaliyah Alleyne has driven this towards sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Tossed-up outside off, Aaliyah Alleyne throws a kitchen sink at it and gets a thick outside edge as it races away from the third man fence. Lucky boundary!
Aaliyah Alleyne walks in.

OUT! Clinical from Muneeba Ali from behind the wickets. Tossed up outside off, Shemaine Campbelle gets tempted and gives it a charge for a big heave but fails to get any bat on this, Keeper Muneeba Ali collects well and removes the bails in a flash.

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up around middle, Shabika Gajnabi has pushed this towards short mid-wicket for a single.
Short-pitched on top of off, Shabika Gajnabi has cut this towards a backward point for a couple. Appeal for run out but the batter is well inside her crease.
Loopy full toss in middle, Shemaine Campbelle has slogged this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower one, outside off, Shabika Gajnabi looks to cut it but gets beaten.
Shabika Gajnabi walks in as the new batter.

OUT! PLUMB! This one lands on middle and leg, it keeps a tad low, Chinelle Henry looks to heave it but misses and gets rapped on her pads. A loud appeal and the finger goes up. Chinelle Henry goes upstairs. Fair delivery and Ultra Edge shows a flat line. Ball Tracking shows three reds and Chinelle Henry makes her way back into the hut. West Indies Women go three down in a jiffy now!
FOUR! Slightly shorter and has some width on offer, Chinelle Henry hangs back and cuts it through point as the ball finds the fence.
Darts in on middle, Chinelle Henry blocks it back. Three dots now!
Lands it just outside off, Chinelle Henry looks to cut it but gets beaten.
Quicker one on middle, Chinelle Henry blocks it back.
Bowls it fuller this time, Shemaine Campbelle eases it to the woman at mid off. Ends with a dot.
Another one outside off, Shemaine Campbelle tries to cut it but misses.
This one lands outside off as well, Shemaine Campbelle covers her line and lets it go.
Full and outside off, Chinelle Henry drives it to deep covers for one.
Wide! Bowls it wide outside off, Chinelle Henry offers no shot.
Lands it outside off, it turns away a shade, Chinelle Henry misses her stroke.
FOUR! Tossed up, outside off, Chinelle Henry picks it well and drives it uppishly over covers for a boundary! What a shot that is.
Flighted up, around middle and leg, Chinelle Henry cuts it to covers for one again.
Fuller and on off, Shemaine Campbelle pushes it to mid off for one.
Slower one, on off, Chinelle Henry cuts it to covers and gets off the mark. Single taken.
Chinelle Henry joins Shemaine Campbelle in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! That was a soft dismissal. Tossed up, slower through the air, Rashada Williams looks to loft it but gets the toe end of her bat. It lobs back towards Rashada Williams who takes a dolly. Rashada Williams makes her way back into the shed after a fine knock!
Drags her length back and bowls it outside off, Rashada Williams punches it but finds the woman at covers.
Bowls it outside off, it skids through, Shemaine Campbelle slaps it towards covers for one.
Sadia Iqbal is back into the action.
Slightly shorter and on off, Rashada Williams pulls it over mid-wicket for a brace.
Play and a miss. Lands it outside off with a hint of turn, Rashada Williams looks to slog it but misses.
Tossed up, on off, Rashada Williams punches it but finds the woman at covers.
Fuller and on off, Shemaine Campbelle taps it to covers for one.
Another one outside off, Shemaine Campbelle drives it towards deep covers for a brace.
Bowls it full, keeps it low, Rashada Williams slogs it over mid-wicket for one.
Nashra Sandhu continues from the other end.
Another one outside off, Rashada Williams guides it towards backward point for one.
Slower one, outside off, Rashada Williams misses her stroke as the ball bounces to the right of the keeper.
Fine timing. Lands it on off, Rashada Williams picks it well and drives it uppishly over covers for a brace.
Slightly shorter and keeps it outside off, Shemaine Campbelle slaps it to point for one.
Flighted up, on off, Shemaine Campbelle taps it to the cover fielder.
Bowls it full and on off, Rashada Williams drives it to mid off for one.

Drinks! A fine, fine start from the West Indies Women and they will need to pull the gear up now and post a good total on the board. Pakistan Women will look for some quick wickets and get the game under their control. The scoreboard reads 61/1 at the halfway stage.
Tossed up outside off, Rashada Williams has lofted this inside out over towards deep extra-cover for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Rashada Williams has cut this towards point for no run.
A bit of bounce here, Shemaine Campbelle has guided this towards sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up in middle, Shemaine Campbelle gives it a charge down the ground and drills this back to the bowler.
Flatter around off, Shemaine Campbelle has blocked this out.
Tossed up in middle, Shemaine Campbelle has flicked this towards deep square leg or a couple.
Fuller one outside off, Rashada Williams has pushed this to the fielder at short cover.
Flighted around middle, Shemaine Campbelle has placed this towards long on for a single.

FOUR! Wow, timing at it's very best here from the big blade of Shemaine Campbelle. Short and outside off, Shemaine Campbelle has punched this off the backfoot for a boundary past the fielder at cover.
Fuller one around off, Rashada Williams has driven this pas the diving cover for a single towards long off
Fuller one around off, Rashada Williams hs pushed this towards cover-point for no run.
FOUR! Sweet timing. Fuller and on off, Williams reads the line of the ball early and drives it to deep cover as the ball finds the gap and races away for a boundary.
Nashra Sandhu comes into the attack now.
On a length around middle, Shemaine Campbelle has nudged this wide of the short mid-wicket fielder for a couple.
Full toss around middle, Shemaine Campbelle has lofted this over the infield on the on side for a couple towards deep mid-wicket.
Fuller one around middle, Shemaine Campbelle has pushed this towards mid on.
On a length around off, Rashada Williams lofts this just over the fielder at covers for a single.
Length delivery around off, Shemaine Campbelle has pushed this towards extra cover for a single.
On a length around off, Rashada Williams has slapped this towards fine leg for a single.

Fuller one around middle, Rashada Williams has punched this down the ground for a single towards long on.
A couple of byes as the keeper fails to collect this cleanly. Floater outside off, Rashada Williams pokes and misses. A couple taken as the ball is headed behind the stumps.
Fuller delivery around off, Shemaine Campbelle has swept this well for a single towards deep square leg.
Flighted around pads, Rashada Williams has swept this towards deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up around off, Shemaine Campbelle pushes this towards long on for a single.
Beauty by Nida Dar as she beats the outside edge of Shemaine Campbelle's bat with a floater outside off.
Powerplay is done! It's a good start for West Indies Women but losing Hayley Matthews was a big blow.

Fuller and on off, driven back to the bowler.

OUT! Fatima Sana draws first blood for the Asian side as she removes Hayley Matthews from the middle. Fuller delivery around the pads, Hayley Matthews looks to flick this out of the park on the on side but finds the fielder at the square leg boundary. Sidra Ameen makes no mistake and it's a big breakthrough for Pakistan Women!
Commentary.Howout: c Sidra Ameen b Fatima Sana

Commentary.Commentary: Length delivery around middle, Hayley Matthews has blocked this out towards mid on.
Full and outside off, Hayley Matthews has cut this fine towards the right of third man for a couple.
Fuller delivery drifting down leg, Rashada Williams pushes it towards mid on for a single. The fielder has a shy at the stumps but misses.
Excellent over from Dar. Short and outside off, Hayley Matthews goes back to cut but ends up chopping it towards backward point.

Shortish and on off, punched to covers.
Attempts to drive but inside-edges it instead. It rolls behind square leg for one.

Given lbw! Aiman Anwer once again gets a full ball to swing into the batter. It's around middle and Rashada Williams fails to flick after leaning across a bit in her stance. She is rapped on the pads, they appeal and the finger goes up. Hayley Matthews advises her partner to take the DRS. The Ball Tracking shows that it's missing the leg stump. The decision is reversed and Williams survives.
Full toss, on the pads, Hayley misses out as she can only fetch a run by hitting it towards deep backward square leg.
Short in length and wide outside off, Rashada cuts it towards short third man and rushes to the other end.
Bowls it full, around off and angling in, Hayley clips it through square leg and takes a single.

Fuller in length, around off and swinging in, Williams prods and drives it to covers.

Skidding in from around off, Hayley gets back and pushes it to mid on.
Shortish and on middle, Matthews goes back and plays it down to mid-wicket. Straight to the fielder.
Arm ball, around off, Rashada Williams tries to defend but it takes the inner edge. The ball rolls in the gap at mid-wicket and they cross.
Shout for an lbw! Not given. Arm ball, full and around leg, Rashada Williams tries to flick but misses. She is hit on the pads, they appeal but it's going down leg.
West Indies Women are away! Tossed up around middle, Hayley Matthews works it in the gap at short mid-wicket and rushes to the other end.
Loopy delivery, full and on middle, Hayley helps it towards backward square leg and looks for a run. She is sent back.

We are moments away from the start of the game as all the players are out in the middle. Hayley Matthews is accompanied by Rashada Williams for the Indies and it will be Sadia Iqbal to start the proceeding for Pakistan Women.
The teams are out in the middle for their respective National Anthems. The conditions are bright and sunny and it's looking very good for batting.

Pakistan Women (Playing XI) - Sidra Ameen (In for Javeria Khan), Muneeba Ali (WK), Bismah Maroof (C), Nida Dar, Aliya Riaz, Omaima Sohail (In for Ayesha Naseem), Fatima Sana, Aiman Anwer, Tuba Hassan, Nashra Sandhu, Sadia Iqbal.

West Indies Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Hayley Matthews (C), Rashada Williams (WK), Shemaine Campbelle, Shabika Gajnabi, Chinelle Henry, Aaliyah Alleyne, Zaida James, Trishan Holder, Afy Fletcher, Shamilia Connell, Karishma Ramharack.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of Hayley Matthews! West Indies Women will bat first!

The battle will be exciting as both are entering this game on the back of a win. The stake is higher for Pakistan Women in this contest but they are facing West Indies Women against whom they have a very lopsided head-to-head record. Out of the 16 T20Is played, the team from Asia has won only thrice. Can they improve this record and stay relevant in the tournament?

West Indies Women have not had the best of campaigns as they have already lost to England Women and India Women. They are almost out of the race for the semis but a win against Ireland Women would have given them some confidence. Overdependency on Hayley Matthews has cost them in this tournament and they will hope that others step up in this game and share the responsibility.

Pakistan started off their campaign with a defeat against their arch-rivals India but came back strongly in the second game where they defeated Ireland convincingly. Muneeba Ali scored a century in the last game and the team would be relying heavily on her to deliver well yet again. They are still in the hunt for a place in the semis and will be looking to win this must-win contest.
Hello and welcome to this mouth-watering encounter between Pakistan Women and West Indies Women as they go head-to-head in an entertaining Group B fixture at the Boland Park in Paarl.
... MATCH DAY ...

We arrive at the crucial part of the group stages in the Women’s T20 World Cup 2023 with teams now booking their spots for the semi-finals and any misstep at this juncture will spell the end of the losing team’s campaign. We focus our attention on match number 16 in which Pakistan Women will clash against West Indies Women and both teams find their World Cup hopes hanging in the balance having suffered disappointing defeats so far. They do come into this one on the back of crucial wins with both sides defeating Ireland Women in their last fixture. Pakistan Women have played just two games and registered a statement win last time around after losing their opening game against India Women. They were dominant in all aspects of the game winning by a massive margin of 70 runs and will be looking to carry that form into this game. Their batting display was carried by a spectacular inning from their opener Muneeba Ali who scored the first century by a Pakistan Women's batter in a T20I. They have a strong top order composed of Javeria Khan, Bismah Maroof, and Nida Dar but the former two had a disappointing outing in a game where they should have had the upper hand. Nida Dar played the supporting role with the bat along with a remarkable spell with the ball and her all-round abilities will be really important in the remaining two group stage games. Ayesha Naseem and Aliya Riaz bring their hard-hitting abilities into the game from lower down the order. Their strength lies in their spin-bowling contingent and they claimed nine of the ten wickets that fell in the previous match which is the most Pakistan Women have managed in a World Cup game. Nashra Sandhu has been in remarkable form in the competition so far and has got ample support from Sadia Iqbal, Nida Dar, and Tuba Hassan but they do need a bit more from their pace bowlers. West Indies Women lost their first two games but kept their hopes faintly alive with a close win against Ireland Women. They need to win this game by a massive margin to boost their net run rate and also pray that other results go in their favor. Their batting is heavily dependent on Hayley Matthews and they will be boosted by the return of their skipper Rashada Williams to the side. There have been small contributions from Shemaine Campbelle, Chinelle Henry, and Shabika Gajnabi but they need to convert these starts to bigger scores. They have a few good spinners in their ranks as well with Karishma Ramharack and Afy Fletcher doing a decent job and Shamilia Connell is a constant danger with her pace. Will they be able to grab a win in what could be their last match of the tournament? Or will Pakistan Women boost their chances of claiming a semi-final spot? We will find out soon.
